Soils · Ground data

Where observations exist

What is recorded, and how deep?

A deep profile does not necessarily provide continuous sampling or a complete carbon stock. Missing or unverified values remain distinct from zero.

Depth profiles, distributions and site stocks

Organic surface layers removed under the source preparation rule.

Each depth may contain different profiles. Site stocks are kg C/m² at stated depths, not landscape totals. Eligibility, coarse-fragment treatment and measured/estimated flags still apply. Wide figures can be scrolled on a phone.

Stocks for a chosen area

For either domain: select a boundary, a product and a compatible pool/depth/year. Report what area is represented.

TO ADD · NO TOTAL CALCULATED

At observed sites

Stock density at a stated interval/pool, usually kg C/m². Complete depth coverage and measurement/estimation flags retained.

Plot total requires its measured area. A sum of sampled sites is not a regional estimate.

Within a chosen boundary

Pixel stock density × the represented area, summed over valid coverage. Report tonnes or Tg C, with missing area visible.

Alternative products are compared on common support; overlapping estimates are not added.

Area summaryValueNeeded before calculation
Boundary and sizeNot selectedCanada, ecozone, province or supplied polygon
Product definitionSelection requiredQuantity, version, depth/pool and year
Valid mapped areaNot calculatedPixel areas, masks, coverage and boundary weights
Mean stock densityNot calculatedArea-weighted mean over valid area
Total carbonNot calculatedSum stock density × area; explicit mass unit
UncertaintyNot calculatedSource statistic and defensible aggregation method
What makes area totals comparable?

Same boundary and common valid area; compatible quantity, carbon pool, depth/datum and reference period. Show each product's own coverage too. Missing pixels are not zero, and partial coverage is not automatically scaled to the whole area.

For kg C/m², sum value × represented m². Divide kg by 1,000 for tonnes C or by 1,000,000,000 for Tg C. Concentration alone cannot supply this total.
